rachel: Heads-up: found a reproducible parity/DX issue in the Java/Kotlin sample app. On Android 14 emulator, OkHttp following redirects (307/308) drops the Authorization header on the redirected request. Pixel 4 (Android 12) is fine.
marco: is this only with the app interceptor?
rachel: yes. Minimal setup: MockWebServer returns 307 -> /next. Client uses addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor). If I switch to followRedirects(false) the header remains.
eden: paste the interceptor and client config?
rachel: interceptor: 
```kotlin
class AuthInterceptor(private val tokenProvider: TokenProvider): Interceptor {
  override fun intercept(chain: Interceptor.Chain): Response {
    val token = tokenProvider.current()
    val req = chain.request().newBuilder()
      .addHeader("Authorization", "Bearer $token")
      .build()
    return chain.proceed(req)
  }
}
```
client: OkHttpClient.Builder().followRedirects(true).addInterceptor(AuthInterceptor(...)).build()

peter: try .header("Authorization", ...) instead of addHeader. Also try addNetworkInterceptor.
rachel: .header(...) fixed the tiny repro on emulator. Moving to addNetworkInterceptor also preserved header but broke our token refresh flow because Authenticator sees different call context.
ci-bot: created INF-4399: "Auth header lost on 3xx redirect with app interceptor (emulator-14)" and attached repro.
yasmin: short-term: update sample README with the emulator-14 caveat and show two workarounds: (1) use .header(...) in interceptor, or (2) set followRedirects(false) and re-attach headers when following Location manually. Also add a MockWebServer integration test that runs on emulator-14 in CI.
marco: long-term we should document interceptor vs Authenticator semantics (app vs network) in the SDK auth guide and add a troubleshooting section for redirects.
rachel: i'll open a small PR with the MockWebServer test + README note and ping for device validation. Happy to paste the full repro script for anyone who wants to run locally. :thumbsup:
